rule: one plan, run once; no retry; a failed sample stays
slot: declared, not exercised: vm start runs without --wait, so a full slot fails the acquisition at once with VM_LIMIT_REACHED, and the boot bound limits it

calls.name: identity
argv: cd /opt/testanyware && find . -type f -name '*.py' | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum; cat /etc/os-release; uname -a

calls.name: timeout
argv:
d=/tmp/taw-k223/timeout
mkdir -p "$d"
sleep 120 & child=$!
printf '%s\n' "$child" > "$d/child.pid"
printf 'partial\n' > "$d/partial"
printf 'partial-out\n'
printf 'partial-err\n' >&2
wait

calls.name: after-timeout-01
argv:
f=/tmp/taw-k223/timeout/child.pid
if ! pid=$(cat "$f"); then printf 'child pid-file=unreadable\n'; exit 0; fi
printf 'child pid=%s\n' "$pid"
ps -p "$pid" -o pid=,ppid=,pgid=,stat=,lstart=,args=
printf 'child ps-exit=%s\n' "$?"

calls.name: interrupt-child
argv:
f=/tmp/taw-k223/interrupt/child.pid
if ! pid=$(cat "$f"); then printf 'child pid-file=unreadable\n'; exit 0; fi
printf 'child pid=%s\n' "$pid"
n=0
while :; do
n=$((n + 1))
ps -p "$pid" -o pid=,ppid=,pgid=,stat=,lstart=,args=
e=$?
printf 'child ps-exit=%s\n' "$e"
if [ "$e" -ne 0 ] || [ "$n" -ge 41 ]; then break; fi
sleep 0.1
done

cleanup.name: cleanup
argv:
state() {
  if err=$(kill -0 "$1" 2>&1); then echo alive
  else case "$err" in
    *[Nn]o\ such\ process*) echo gone ;;
    *) echo unknown ;;
  esac; fi
}
wait_gone() {
  i=0
  while [ "$(state "$1")" = alive ] && [ "$i" -lt "$2" ]; do
    sleep 0.1; i=$((i + 1))
  done
}
outcome=confirmed
for f in /tmp/taw-k223/timeout/child.pid /tmp/taw-k223/cancel/child.pid /tmp/taw-k223/interrupt/child.pid; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  pid=$(cat "$f")
  cmd=$(ps -p "$pid" -o args= | sed 's/ *$//')
  printf '%s pid=%s command=%s\n' "$f" "$pid" "$cmd"
  if [ "$cmd" != "sleep 120" ]; then
    s=$(state "$pid")
    if [ -z "$cmd" ] && [ "$s" = gone ]; then printf 'gone pid=%s\n' "$pid"
    elif [ -n "$cmd" ] && [ "$s" = alive ]; then printf 'other pid=%s\n' "$pid"
    else printf 'unknown pid=%s state=%s\n' "$pid" "$s"; outcome=uncertain; fi
    continue
  fi
  kill -TERM "$pid"
  wait_gone "$pid" 20
  action=terminated
  if [ "$(state "$pid")" = alive ]; then
    kill -KILL "$pid"; action=killed
    wait_gone "$pid" 5
  fi
  s=$(state "$pid")
  if [ "$s" = gone ]; then printf '%s pid=%s\n' "$action" "$pid"
  else printf 'survived pid=%s state=%s\n' "$pid" "$s"; outcome=uncertain; fi
done
printf 'cleanup %s\n' "$outcome"
[ "$outcome" = confirmed ]
